scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @novi/api
scripts.dev:mobile: npm run build:shared && npm run start --workspace @novi/mobile
scripts.dev:console: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @novi/console
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
